verdict.rationale: Lambda's documentation says every on-demand instance comes with Lambda Stack, a preinstalled set of AI/ML drivers, tools and frameworks, plus JupyterLab. A 'GPU Base' image and alternative base images are selectable via the API, so developers don't start from a bare OS. However, the evidence names no specific framework and shows no app-level template catalog. Missing for 10: explicitly documented PyTorch/CUDA contents, vLLM and ComfyUI templates, a browsable one-click template marketplace, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Lambda also preinstalls Lambda Stack, a standard set of AI/ML-related drivers, tools, and frameworks, on the instance
GPU Base: An image based on Ubuntu Server that includes a minimal set of key AI/ML tools and drivers.
If you launch your instance using the Lambda Cloud API, you can choose to use an alternative base image instead.
